description: This file implements the UserPreferences plugin for a software framework, providing functionality to get and set user interface language preferences via JSON-RPC methods. It includes registration, initialization, and method implementations for reading and writing to a configuration file using GLib's GKeyFile API.

classes.name: UserPreferences
classes.description: A plugin class that manages user interface language preferences, providing JSON-RPC methods to retrieve and set the language setting, and handling plugin lifecycle events.

methods.name: UserPreferences::getUILanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the UI language setting from the configuration file and returns it via JSON response.

methods.name: UserPreferences::setUILanguage
methods.description: Sets the UI language in the configuration file based on JSON parameters received.
